jobs.title: Software Engineer (Product - Backend)
jobs.description:
**About Vasco**
---------------

Vasco is the revenue context layer for AI agents. The product was built around one idea: confident is not the same as correct, and revenue decisions get made on confidence all the time. We structure your CRM, billing, calls, and support data into a semantic layer where every metric is sourced, every definition is locked, and every answer is deterministic, then build agents that take the manual busywork off people's plates.

Our cofounders Guillaume and Seb already built and sold one startup together; today they are building the product they wished they had. Vasco's mission is to enable builders and GTM leaders to build a revenue engine that moves the business forward on data they can trust.

Curious how we build? Take a look at our young engineering blog.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Software Engineer at Vasco, you'll build the brain of our agents: the core systems that give them the context, metrics, and playbooks they need to do their job. You'll join a small team of product designers and engineers reporting to our CTO, and work closely with our DevOps, Platform, Data, and Agent teams. The mission is to make GTM agents production-ready: reliable, fast, context-aware, and triggered at the right moment. You'll help shape solutions, then carry them through implementation to release. Twelve months in, winning means our agents run on systems you shaped, shipped, and saw adopted, and you’re able to tackle hard and crunchy problems.

We're open to different levels of seniority. This is not an entry-level position: the problems are hard, the architecture is complex, and you'll own technical decisions and their implementation. We expect high autonomy and accountability at every level, and the scope you own grows with your experience. We'll meet you where you are, and what matters is that you make the team better and more capable of facing complex technical challenges.

We're an early-stage startup working at the frontier of what agents can do in GTM. The path is often foggy, so you should be ready to bring clarity to it with your team, stretch beyond your comfort zone, stay open-minded, and wear more hats than your title suggests. You're AI-forward and you actively contribute to how we work with AI as a team. AI can make engineering lonely, and we push back on that with close collaboration, a fun environment, and a team that stays human.

*For transparency, the internal title for this role is Software Developer.*

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Backend-focused, full-slice development:** Design, build, and ship the backend behind Vasco, including challenging parts like our context graph and our metric engine, where formula accuracy is key, and own full slices of work, including front end and data visualization when the feature calls for it, with human review sized to the risk.
* **Shaping to adoption:** Shape solutions with designers, engineers, and GTM teammates in our Shape Up process, at the technical level and the business level, turn intent and design into the right context for Claude to implement, then instrument the release and follow adoption with your team.
* **Infrastructure, security, and data trust:** Build services that handle customer revenue data safely and own the infrastructure and security of the parts you build, with guidance and tooling from DevOps, since the product's promise rests on data our customers can trust.
* **AI-native practices:** Help build our backend harness and blueprints, the standards Claude reads so it builds the way we want, so more of your time goes to thinking, technical design, and shaping as AI handles more of the mechanical coding.
* **Incident ownership:** Own your incidents: if you break something in production, you fix it, and you step up for your team the same way, communicating fast and transparently so we know about problems before customers do, because reliability is what we sell.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* **Customer-facing systems.** You've spent at least four years building systems that have touched customers, and your technical decisions trace back to the customer problems they solve.
* **Backend depth.** You've designed, built, and operated production backend services, you design complete systems with the big picture of a feature in mind, and you're comfortable working on a data-heavy infrastructure product like ours. Experience with part of our stack (GCP, BigQuery, Node.js, TypeScript, Terraform) or its equivalents in other clouds is ideal.
* **AI-forward, with healthy skepticism.** You've made AI coding tools central to how you ship, you own and can defend the output you ship, and you build the checks that let you ship with evidence. We'll ask you to show how you run your development lifecycle with AI.
* **High-stakes judgment.** You've made decisions where the cost of being wrong was real, at the scale you've worked at, and you can walk through how you decided.
* **Communication clarity.** You can turn technical trade-offs into clear business impact for any audience, from developers to cofounders.
* **Collaboration.** You've pulled people into your work, you enjoy working as a team, and you contribute to the culture around you.

**What'll make you stand out**
------------------------------

* **Rust or Go.** You've shipped production services in Rust or Go, which we're seriously considering alongside TypeScript and Node for high-performance, type-safe workloads.
* **Context layers for agents.** You've built data or context layers that AI agents consume in production, including context graph architectures.
* **Data engineering or DevOps range.** You can drop into data engineering work (SQL, data modeling, pipelines) or DevOps work (infrastructure, CI/CD, observability) when the problem calls for it.

jobs.title: Domain Cloud Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Role description**

**Domain Cloud Software Developer**

**Who We Are:**

Born digital, UST transforms lives through the power of technology. We walk alongside our clients and partners, embedding innovation and agility into everything they do. We help them create transformative experiences and human-centered solutions for a better world.

UST is a mission-driven group of 29,000+ practical problem solvers and creative thinkers in more than 30 countries. Our entrepreneurial teams are empowered to innovate, act nimbly, and create a lasting and sustainable impact for our clients, their customers, and the communities in which we live.

With us, you’ll create a boundless impact that transforms your career—and the lives of people across the world.

Visit us at UST.com.

**You Are:**

We are seeking a highly skilled Domain Cloud Software Developer to design, develop, deploy, and maintain cloud-native applications and data-driven solutions on AWS. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in backend development using Node.js, cloud services, infrastructure automation, containerized environments, and modern software engineering practices.

**The opportunity:**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications and APIs using Node.js.

* Build and manage cloud-native solutions on AWS, leveraging services such as Lambda, Step Functions, AWS Batch, ECS/Fargate, and API Gateway.

* Develop and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning and management.

* Design, optimize, and maintain SQL and NoSQL databases, ensuring high performance, scalability, and data integrity.

* Develop, deploy, and manage containerized applications using Docker and container orchestration platforms such as AWS ECS/Fargate.

* Collaborate with frontend teams to build responsive user interfaces using React, or work with data engineering teams to develop data pipelines and processing solutions.

* Integrate backend services, databases, and third-party APIs to support business requirements.

* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize application performance, reliability, and security in cloud environments.

* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical design decisions and best practices.

This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

**What you** **need:**

* Years Of Experience Required: 7+

* Education Requirement:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

* The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in backend development using Node.js, cloud services, infrastructure automation, containerized environments, and modern software engineering practices.

* Experience in the insurance or reinsurance industry is preferred.

* This role requires collaboration with cross-functional teams to build scalable, secure, and highly available cloud solutions while driving innovation and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle.

* Required:

* Node.js

* AWS (Amazon Web Services, Step Functions, AWS Batch, Lambdas, ECS, API Gateway)

* Infrastructure as code

* SQL Relational/NoSQL database

* Docker/Linux Containers and Container orchestration (e.g. ECS/Fargate)

* React or Data Engineering

* Great to have:

* Terraform, Jenkins/Github Actions

* Nice to have: DBT/Qlik Replication, Snowflake, C# dotNet (Core and Framework), Angular, Groovy, Python, Shell Scripting

* Preferred:

* Insurance and/or reinsurance industry knowledge Advanced knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle

Compensation can differ depending on factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, education, and level of experience. UST provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in various U.S. markets as set forth below.

**Role Location:** **Remote- Canada**

**Compensation Range**: $95,000-$119,000

**Benefits**

Full-time, regular employees accrue a minimum of 10 days of paid vacation per year, receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year), paid holidays, and are eligible for paid bereavement leave and jury duty. They and their dependents residing in Canada are eligible for Supplemental Healthcare coverage, as well as Company-paid Employee Only basic life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment coverage.

Full-time temporary employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year). They and their dependents residing in Canada are eligible for Supplemental Healthcare coverage, as well as Company-paid Employee Only basic life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment coverage.

Part-time regular and temporary employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year).

All Canadian employees who work in a province, territory or locality with more generous paid sick leave benefits than specified here will receive the benefit of those sick leave laws.

**What we believe:**

We proudly embrace the values that have shaped UST since day one. We build our culture of Humility, Humanity, and Integrity. These values inspire us to nurture a people-first, human centric culture that fosters diversity, prioritizes sustainable solutions, and keeps our people and clients at the forefront of all decisions.

**Humility:**

We will listen, learn, be empathetic and help selflessly in our interactions with everyone.

**Humanity:**

Through business, we will better the lives of those less fortunate than ourselves.

**Integrity:**

We honor our commitments and act with responsibility in all our relationships.
